<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **7** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via PageSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`  _(via PageSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **171** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ebfa2bfa180124c403fc037fbea7a23738e30394` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d29a6ccfc9ed0f15c2c6f545722c5eb38c382b5a` — the merge of head `bf5e6e03cbfdd1db4902f32f6b171d45edddec04` into base `ebfa2bfa180124c403fc037fbea7a23738e30394`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d29a6ccfc9ed0f15c2c6f545722c5eb38c382b5a && git checkout d29a6ccfc9ed0f15c2c6f545722c5eb38c382b5a
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin ebfa2bfa180124c403fc037fbea7a23738e30394 bf5e6e03cbfdd1db4902f32f6b171d45edddec04 && git checkout -B drift-repro ebfa2bfa180124c403fc037fbea7a23738e30394 && git merge --no-ff bf5e6e03cbfdd1db4902f32f6b171d45edddec04

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ebfa2bfa180124c403fc037fbea7a23738e30394
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs ebfa2bfa180124c403fc037fbea7a23738e30394` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a7b75867566ad93a01a4e833bdabde32e30e2679`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.page-record-no-component-refused.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/page.form.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts + packages/spec/src/ui/page.test.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-page-record-no-component.test.ts, ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts, .changeset/32434-record-page-no-component-refused.md and content/docs/ui/pages.mdx (the last two read only for agreement with the contract)

Inputs read: card #32434 body and both comments (triage 6799161795, seat claim and ruling 6801908519; no earlier contract-review record exists), the PR body, the 34-file net diff against merge base 14754c70, and the live tree at the head. Consumer code read, not reviewed: ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx, ui/packages/react/src/hooks/usePageAssignment.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx, PageView.tsx, metadata-admin/anchors.ts and previews/PagePreview.tsx.

Check-runs on the head (PR #32471, read at the end of this review, 37 runs): 9 completed success — Auto Label, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Spec property liveness, filter, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Documentation Links, Flag docs affected by code changes. 9 skipped — Dogfood Verify CLI, the Dogfood Regression Gate matrix job, UI Published Artifacts, Temporal Conformance, 18.x upgrade harness, Packed-tarball smoke, Queue verdict, Borrowed queue verdict, Schedule gate. 19 still in progress — Build Core, Build UI Deps, Build Docs, Plan Test Core shards, Plan Test UI shards, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, every Lint job (8) and every Type Check job (4). No test shard had reported. Nothing the PR body says about local suites, the ablation or the gate sweep is adopted here.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Accept-set of `PageSchema`: a page of kind `full` (or absent) and type `record` (or absent) with no region holding a component is now refused at `regions`. For the card's page (`type: 'record'`, `object` set, no regions) this is RIGHT: `RecordDetailView` renders an assigned full page as authored, `RecordPageLayout` falls to `FlatContent`, which draws `children` (not a spec key), and `PageRenderer` hides both title and description when the page type is `record`. The panel is blank, as the card measured.
2. Regions present but every `components` list empty also refused: RIGHT. `RegionLayout` draws empty regions.
3. Absent `type` judged as `record`: RIGHT against the spec default (`PAGE_TYPE_DEFAULT`) and against the console, since the protocol stores and serves the declared default and `isRecordPageOf` reads `type === 'record'`.
4. `home`, `app`, `utility` unchanged: RIGHT. `PageRenderer` draws the label as the heading, and the description, for every type but `record` when no `page:header` owns the title.
5. `list`, `slotted`, `html`, `react` not judged: RIGHT, and matches the seat ruling.
6. The same refusal applied to a record-typed or untyped page that carries `interfaceConfig.source`: WRONG. See ④ finding 1. `PageView.tsx` line 510 draws `InterfaceListPage` for any page with `interfaceConfig.source`, whatever its `type`, and no spec check ties `interfaceConfig` to `type: 'list'`.
7. Public surface: one new export, `checkPageRecordPlacesComponent`, present in `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins/ui.json`. RIGHT, additive, attached by identifier like its siblings.
8. `print` refusal text on a full page with no regions: the old text claimed a synthesized default layout that no full page draws; the new text is RIGHT. A full record page with `print` and no regions now gets two issues (`print` and `regions`); both are true.
9. `regions` describe, the form comment and `pages.mdx` drop the fallback claim: RIGHT in that respect. The console never fell back.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec` minor, marked BREAKING, with `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` on both the changeset and the PR body, matching the seat's claim on the card. The level agrees with what the diff publishes: one additive export and one accept-set narrowing, registered as an ADR-0087 semantic entry with no conversion. Nothing is widened. The Check Changeset run had not concluded when this record was written. The changeset's Before paragraph repeats the false `interfaceConfig` sentence (④ finding 1) and must move with the fix.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Stored rows in the console (PR body, for domain:ui): confirmed as described. `usePageAssignment` and `RecordDetailView` do not read `_diagnostics`, so a stored empty record page still draws blank. This is the follow-up the seat ruling already names; no `ui/**` source moves in this diff.
- Whether `PageKindNodeSchema` attaches the check (for domain:ui): correctly left open. The census lists the check as not attachable on `PageNodeSchema`, where `type` is the discriminator `'page'`; that reasoning holds.
- "Not yet accepted" edits to the two `usePageAssignment` test files: test-only fixture moves outside this review's scope. They are the lane seat's ACCEPT, and the seat has to rule on the file-surface addition; it is not answered here.
- Studio create seed: the PR body says the one remaining path is the `return {}` when the object fetch fails. `anchors.ts` has more: a full record page created with no `object` (`object` is not required by the create schema), a falsy object definition, the catch, and a synthesized page with no regions. All now end in 422 with the sentence, which is better than storing a blank page, but the body's count is wrong. Nit on the PR body.
- Installed packages: the changeset and the semantic entry say a package whose body carries such a page is refused when it registers, an installed one included. Artifact package bodies do parse `pages` through `PageSchema` (`stack.zod.ts`), so the claim is plausible, but no test in this diff pins it and the seat ruling names only the save door, `os validate` / `os build` and `defineStack`. A whole package failing to register is a wider effect than one blank page. ESCALATED to the seat: confirm the unplaced-region precedent is the intended behaviour here too.
- ESCALATED to the seat with ④ finding 1: is `interfaceConfig.source` on a page that is not `type: 'list'` a supported page (exempt it from this check), or a shape to refuse on its own terms with its own sentence?

### ④ Design judgment

**packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts**

1. must-fix — the check refuses a page the console draws, and three contract sentences say otherwise. The jsdoc of `checkPageRecordPlacesComponent` states that `interfaceConfig` is not read on a `full` page; the changeset, the semantic entry's `reason` and the PR body's measurement 2 repeat it, and `page.test.ts` pins `{ object, interfaceConfig: { source } }` as a refused row labelled "not read there". Against the cited consumer that is true only on the record route. `PageView.tsx` line 510 branches on `interfaceConfig?.source` alone and renders `InterfaceListPage`; Studio's `PagePreview.tsx` line 112 makes the same type-blind reading. On main, `{ name: 'open_cases', label: 'Open cases', interfaceConfig: { source: 'case' } }` (no `type`, so a record page by default; no `object`) parses and opens from its navigation item as a working list. On this head it is refused with "every record of its object would open on a blank detail panel ... delete the page so the object's default record page draws", which is false for it: it has no object, is never selected by `usePageAssignment`, and is not blank. That is a delivered capability taken away at the consumer, not the spec's own refusal made real, and it falls outside the ruling's "list pages and other types keep accepting no regions" only because of a defaulted `type`. The first-party count of 0 does not cover stored rows or third-party packages. Fix one way or the other under a seat ruling: exempt a page carrying `interfaceConfig.source`, or refuse that shape separately with a sentence that prescribes `type: 'list'`. Then correct the jsdoc, changeset, entry and the test row. With `object` also set the page is blank on the record route and a list on the page route; the ruling should say which reading wins.
2. should-fix — the sentence is not accurate for the untyped page. The diff's own fixture moves (cli, objectql, the ui census) show `{ name, label }` pages with no `type` are common and usually meant as home or app pages. For them the refusal is right (the page route draws nothing), but the text speaks of "this record page" and "its object" to an author who wrote neither. When `type` is absent, or no `object` is bound, the sentence should say the type defaulted to `record` and offer `type: 'home'` or `'app'`. The ruling asks for one actionable sentence.
3. nit — the message names two fixes; the changeset, the entry and the docs name three (`kind: 'slotted'`). The slotted route is the one that keeps an `isDefault` or app-scoped page.
4. Holds: the null and non-array handling, the `.shape` mirror reading (absent `type`, `kind`, `regions` each read as the spec default), the retired-kind and bad-enum cases (left to their own refusals), attachment order, and the corrected `regions` comment and describe apart from finding 1.

**packages/spec/src/ui/page.form.ts**

Comment-only change, and it holds: the Layout section is hidden for list pages, `regions` stays not required, and the reason given (a form-level `required` would bind home, app and utility pages too) is correct. No finding.

**packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.page-record-no-component-refused.ts**

5. must-fix (same defect as finding 1) — `reason` asserts "slots and interfaceConfig are not read on a full page"; the `interfaceConfig` half is false against `PageView.tsx`. `surface` and `acceptanceCriteria` therefore tell an upgrader to delete or rewrite an untyped interface page that works today.
6. should-fix — `reason` asserts refusal at package registration, "an installed package body carrying such a page included", with no pin in this diff (see ③).
7. Holds: registered in `migrations/registry.ts`; no tombstone and no conversion is the right shape for an accept-set narrowing with no lossless rewrite; the stored-row behaviour (served unchanged, `_diagnostics.valid` false at `regions`, refused on resave) is pinned in the rest test in this diff, not run by me.

**Implementing files**

- `page.test.ts`: agrees with the code, and so carries finding 1 as a pinned row; it has no control for an untyped page with `interfaceConfig.source`.
- `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` and `spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts`: the count of eight attached checks and the not-attachable listing agree with the schema.
- `meta-page-record-no-component.test.ts`: covers the save door, the three controls and the stored-row path; no package-registration case.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7689350265e145a5b4a898267f57d28f90a8a9f0`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.page-record-no-component-refused.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/page.form.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts + packages/spec/src/ui/page.test.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts, packages/objectql/src/registry-package-record-page-no-component.test.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-page-record-no-component.test.ts, ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts, .changeset/32434-record-page-no-component-refused.md, content/docs/ui/pages.mdx and content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx (the last three read only for agreement with the contract)

Round 2, a delta review of the round-1 record on `a7b75867566ad93a01a4e833bdabde32e30e2679` (PR #32471 comment 6808022421). Inputs read: that record, card #32434 body and both comments (no new ruling since round 1), the 10-file fix delta, and the live tree at the head. Consumer code read, not reviewed: ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx, ui/packages/react/src/hooks/usePageAssignment.ts, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx, packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts.

Check-runs on this head when read (22 runs): 1 completed success — PR-body guards. 3 skipped — Packed-tarball smoke, 18.x upgrade harness, Schedule gate. 18 in progress — Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Documentation Links, Flag docs affected by code changes, the eight Lint jobs and the four Type Check jobs. No build or test job was listed yet, so no test has reported on this head. This verdict is a reading of the tree; nothing here stands in for those runs, and no local result is adopted.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Accept-set, bound record page (kind `full`, type `record` or absent, `object` set, no component placed): still refused at `regions`. RIGHT, as in round 1.
2. Same page also carrying `interfaceConfig.source`: still refused. RIGHT as built. `usePageAssignment` selects it for every record of its object and `RecordDetailView` reads no `interfaceConfig`, so the record view is blank and the sentence is true; the sentence now names `type: 'list'` with an `interfaceConfig.source` as the fix. Which reading should win is still the seat's question (③).
3. Unbound record page (no `object`) with a non-blank `interfaceConfig.source`: no longer judged. RIGHT. `PageView.tsx` line 510 draws it as an interface list whatever its type, and `isRecordPageOf` never selects a page without an object. This restores the page round 1 found wrongly refused.
4. Unbound record page with no source, or a blank one: refused with its own sentence. RIGHT. The page route draws nothing for a record-typed page with no regions (title and description are both hidden for type `record`).
5. `home`, `app`, `utility`, `list`, `slotted`, `html`, `react`: unchanged from round 1. RIGHT.
6. Public surface: unchanged by the fix. The exported check's parameter type gains two optional keys (`object`, `interfaceConfig`); additive.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged and still correct: `@objectstack/spec` minor, marked BREAKING, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, one ADR-0087 semantic entry, no conversion. The changeset's Before, Now, Unchanged and FROM/TO paragraphs now agree with the code, including the exempt shape and the two package doors. Check Changeset had not concluded.

### ③ Boundary flags

- ESCALATED, still open, not made wrong by the fix: is `interfaceConfig.source` on a page that is not `type: 'list'` a supported page, and which reading wins when `object` is also set? The fix takes the narrow position (exempt only when no object is bound; a bound page is refused and told to name `type: 'list'`). Both of its sentences are true against the console. The seat still has to rule.
- ESCALATED, still open, now measured: a release artifact handed whole to the `manifest` service is refused at the page and nothing in it registers; a package body registered flat meets no page parse and installs as before, still drawing the blank panel. Whether the whole-artifact refusal is intended is the seat's call. The flat-install case joins the stored-row question for domain:ui.
- Carried from round 1, unchanged: the stored-row console fallback and the `PageKindNodeSchema` attachment (domain:ui); the "not yet accepted" edits to the two `usePageAssignment` test files (the seat's file-surface ruling); the PR body's undercount of the Studio seed's empty-return paths (nit).
- New in the delta: `packages/metadata/src/serializers/typescript-serializer-annotation.test.ts` — a one-fixture move to `type: 'home'`, outside this scope, the lane seat's ACCEPT.

### ④ Design judgment
